def test_apply_discount_boundaries():
    # percent boundaries inclusive [0, 100]
    assert apply_discount(100, 0) == 100
    assert apply_discount(100, 100) == 0

def test_apply_discount_outside_range_errors():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_discount(100, -0.000001)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_discount(100, 100.000001)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_discount(0, -1)

        apply_discount(0, 101)

def test_apply_discount_float_precision():

    assert apply_discount(1.0, 33.3333) == pytest.approx(0.666667, rel=1e-5)
